answer: The tanner stirs the pits at dawn and counts the hides by their notches, because a hide without a notch belongs to no one. Youth worker registration with youth services council attestation is the notch: three-year degree, 1,000 supervised hours, registration exam, annual renewal. The relic is one hide, soaked and scraped by hands that know the bark liquor. A forged notch is spotted when the hide is stretched, and the river is the forfeit, two years of pit fees paid to the guild and the yard shut for a season. The nadir is the guild register, entered by the master tanner and open to any buyer.
